{"sql": "-- Build the recursive CTE for inventory model
-- Start from December 2018 inventory levels
-- For each month in 2019, subtract sales and restock if below minimum

WITH RECURSIVE inventory_model AS (
    -- Base case: December 2018 starting inventory
    SELECT 
        it.product_id,
        0 AS month_num,  -- 0 = December 2018 (starting point)
        it.qty AS ending_inventory,
        COALESCE(pm.qty_minimum, 0) AS qty_minimum,
        COALESCE(pm.qty_purchase, 0) AS qty_purchase
    FROM inventory_totals it
    LEFT JOIN product_minimums pm ON it.product_id = pm.product_id
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: each month in 2019
    SELECT
        im.product_id,
        im.month_num + 1,
        -- New ending inventory = previous ending - sales + restock if needed
        CASE 
            WHEN (im.ending_inventory - COALESCE(ms.qty, 0)) < im.qty_minimum 
            THEN (im.ending_inventory - COALESCE(ms.qty, 0)) + im.qty_purchase
            ELSE (im.ending_inventory - COALESCE(ms.qty, 0))
        END AS ending_inventory,
        im.qty_minimum,
        im.qty_purchase
